header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner nor any intimation received. Same was the
body: position on last two consecutive dates of hearing and even on 31.10.2026 notice was issued to the petitioner through learned District Judge, Sanghar, so also intimation notice to his counsel, but despite of that none appeared on behalf of the petitioner today which reflects that petitioner and his counsel are not interested to pursue this petition. Under these circumstances, this petition is hereby dismissed for non-prosecution. JUDGE *Salik*
